weight_rule: max(0,1-primary_edge/lambda); flat uses the mean of these same16 weights
common_initialization: reuse saved public-only 500-step FIA warmup pixels and public-model label logits; fresh Adam per arm
lambda_F_rule: identity1; calibrate flat initial public image-gradient norm to identity, then share that fixed scalar with mp; log mp initial norm difference; no later recalibration
baseline_reproduction: post-run compare identity final public pixels/logits with original hybrid; offline compare original image metrics; investigate deviations before interpretation
evaluation: after all final candidates are frozen, offline all16 pixel-MSE Hungarian once per arm; PSNR SSIM VGG LPIPS on same pairs; exact full packet and soft/hard observation fits
decision_rule: report mp-minus-identity, flat-minus-identity, mp-minus-flat; all PSNR up SSIM up LPIPS down means descriptive directional improvement only in this single pilot; report magnitude; tiny differences do not establish robust or practical improvement; mixed directions do not establish improvement; no success cutoff or statistical/general-superiority claim
budget_rule: one fixed three-arm comparison, no sweep, restart, extra iterations, or follow-up experiment
